title: At the Doctor's
description: Four short recordings about being ill: booking an appointment, seeing the doctor, getting medicine and a talk by a nurse.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Making an appointment
parts.intro: You will hear Sam phone a clinic and talk to the receptionist.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Good morning, Green Street Clinic. How can I help you?

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: Hello. I'd like to see the doctor, please. My stomach is OK, but I have a very bad headache.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Can you come today at two o'clock?

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: Sorry, I'm at school until three. Is four o'clock OK?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Let me see. The doctor is busy at four. How about half past four?

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: Yes, that's fine.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Thank you, Sam. Please bring your mother or father with you, because you are only fourteen.

parts.title: Part 2 · In the doctor's room
parts.intro: You will hear Nam talking to Dr Lee.

script.speaker: Dr Lee
script.text: Come in, Nam. Sit down. What's the problem?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: I have a sore throat and a cough. It started three days ago.

script.speaker: Dr Lee
script.text: Do you have a temperature? Let me check. Yes, it's thirty-eight degrees. You have a fever.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Is it serious?

script.speaker: Dr Lee
script.text: No, it's just a cold. You need to stay at home and rest for two days.

script.speaker: Dr Lee
script.text: Drink a lot of water and warm tea with honey. Don't drink cold drinks or eat ice cream.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: OK. Can I play football on Saturday?

script.speaker: Dr Lee
script.text: No, not this week. Wait until next Monday.

parts.title: Part 3 · At the pharmacy
parts.intro: You will hear a pharmacist giving Nam his medicine.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Here is your medicine, Nam. Please listen carefully.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Take one white pill in the morning and one white pill in the evening, after food. Do not take the pills at night.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: This red syrup is for your cough. Take one spoon, three times a day.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: The medicine costs twelve pounds. You can pay at the desk.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: If you still feel ill after three days, come back and see the doctor again.

parts.title: Part 4 · Staying healthy
parts.intro: You will hear the school nurse, Mr Hill, talking to students.

script.speaker: Mr Hill
script.text: Hello, everyone. I'm Mr Hill, the school nurse. Today I want to talk about staying healthy.

script.speaker: Mr Hill
script.text: First, sleep. Children need nine or ten hours of sleep every night. Many students sleep only six hours, and that's not enough.

script.speaker: Mr Hill
script.text: Second, eat well. Have fruit and vegetables every day. Try not to eat too many sweets.

script.speaker: Mr Hill
script.text: Third, move your body. Play sport for one hour every day. Walking to school is a good idea.

script.speaker: Mr Hill
script.text: Finally, wash your hands before you eat. It stops germs. My office is next to the library, so come and see me if you feel ill.
